entries.en: Ador held the door while we carried the wardrobe upstairs.
entries.zh: 我们把衣柜搬上楼时，阿多尔扶着门。

entries.en: Adora found a handwritten recipe inside the old biscuit tin.
entries.zh: 阿多拉在旧饼干盒里发现了一张手写的食谱。

entries.en: The ruined adoratory stood beyond the village's last few houses.
entries.zh: 那座破败的拜神场所坐落在村子最外围的几户人家之外。

entries.en: Adout offered to mend the broken clasp on my necklace.
entries.zh: 阿杜主动提出帮我修项链上坏掉的搭扣。

entries.en: The new adperson asked to speak with customers before planning the campaign.
entries.zh: 那位新来的广告从业者要求先与顾客交谈，再策划广告活动。

entries.en: The student placed the adposition after the noun phrase in her translation.
entries.zh: 那位学生在译文中把置词放在了名词短语之后。

entries.en: The laboratory ordered more adrenin for its ongoing research.
entries.zh: 实验室为正在进行的研究又订购了一些肾上腺素。

entries.en: We repeated the measurement after detecting adrenochrome in the sample.
entries.zh: 检测到样品中有肾上腺素红后，我们重新进行了测量。

entries.en: The assay could not distinguish that adrenocorticosteroid from the other compounds.
entries.zh: 那项测定无法将那种肾上腺皮质类固醇与其他化合物区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 肾上腺脑白质营养不良
entries.en: Their charity concert raised money for research into adrenoleukodystrophy.
entries.zh: 他们的慈善音乐会为肾上腺脑白质营养不良的研究筹集了资金。

entries.en: The researchers examined the shape of the adrenoreceptor before comparing the models.
entries.zh: 研究人员先仔细观察了肾上腺素受体的形状，然后比较这些模型。

entries.en: We followed a narrow path across the adret to a stone hut.
entries.zh: 我们沿着一条小路穿过山的向阳面，来到一间石屋。

entries.en: Adri moved his chair so that everyone could see the screen.
entries.zh: 阿德里挪了挪椅子，让每个人都能看到屏幕。

entries.en: Adria saved the last piece of cake for the neighbour's daughter.
entries.zh: 阿德里亚把最后一块蛋糕留给了邻居的女儿。

entries.en: The handle came off just as Adriaan lifted the suitcase.
entries.zh: 阿德里安刚提起行李箱，提手就脱落了。

entries.en: Adriaen took off his muddy boots before entering the kitchen.
entries.zh: 阿德里安进厨房前脱掉了沾满泥的靴子。

entries.en: Adriana woke to the sound of rain against the tent.
entries.zh: 阿德里亚娜醒来时，听见雨点打在帐篷上的声音。

entries.en: Adriani returned the borrowed violin after fitting a new set of strings.
entries.zh: 阿德里亚尼给借来的小提琴换上一套新琴弦后，归还了它。

entries.en: Adrianna caught the rolling orange before it reached the stairs.
entries.zh: 阿德里安娜在橙子滚到楼梯口之前接住了它。

entries.en: The dispute concerned the adscription of a small farm to the estate.
entries.zh: 那场争议涉及一个小农场对该庄园的归属关系。

entries.en: I signed out of AdSense before switching to my other account.
entries.zh: 切换到另一个账号之前，我先退出了 AdSense。

entries.en: The adsmith cut three words from the slogan without losing its humour.
entries.zh: 广告文案撰写人从标语中删掉了三个词，却保留了它的幽默感。

entries.en: The study compared the adsorbability of two gases on the same surface.
entries.zh: 那项研究比较了两种气体在同一表面上被吸附的能力。

entries.en: She handled the disagreement with an adultness that surprised her teachers.
entries.zh: 她处理那次分歧时表现出的成熟让老师们感到意外。

entries.en: Advani noticed that the parcel had been delivered to the wrong flat.
entries.zh: 阿德瓦尼发现包裹送错了公寓。

entries.en: The cautious minister distrusted the adventurist who urged immediate military action.
entries.zh: 那位谨慎的部长不信任那个主张立即采取军事行动的冒险主义者。

entries.en: I closed the advergame when its cartoon mascot appeared for the fifth time.
entries.zh: 那个卡通吉祥物第五次出现时，我关掉了那款广告游戏。

entries.en: She filled her adversaria with observations from the journey.
entries.zh: 她在自己的杂录中写满了旅途中的见闻。

entries.en: We underestimated the adverseness of the conditions on the ridge.
entries.zh: 我们低估了山脊上条件的不利程度。

entries.en: She put the unopened packet of Advil back on the shelf.
entries.zh: 她把那包未拆封的艾德维尔放回了架子上。

entries.en: Advincula sketched the cracked window before ordering replacement glass.
entries.zh: 阿德文库拉先画下了破裂窗户的样子，然后订购替换玻璃。

entries.en: They disagreed about the advisableness of leaving before dawn.
entries.zh: 他们对天亮前出发是否明智意见不一。

entries.en: He wiped the spilled advocaat from the table with a cloth.
entries.zh: 他用一块布擦掉了洒在桌上的荷兰蛋酒。

entries.en: Her persistent advocation of building a public garden finally won the neighbours' support.
entries.zh: 她持续倡导修建公共花园，终于赢得了邻居们的支持。

entries.meaningZh: 有权推荐受俸牧师的人〔英国法律〕
entries.en: In the novel, the advowee argued with the vicar over a neglected church.
entries.zh: 小说中，那位有权推荐受俸牧师的人因教堂失修与教区牧师发生了争执。

entries.en: Adward packed an extra jumper in case the evening turned cold.
entries.zh: 爱德华多装了一件毛衣，以防晚上变冷。

entries.en: The technician removed the adware that kept opening unwanted shopping windows.
entries.zh: 技术人员删除了那个不断弹出恼人购物窗口的广告软件。

entries.en: An experienced adwoman challenged the campaign's assumptions about older customers.
entries.zh: 一位经验丰富的女广告从业者质疑了那项广告活动对年长顾客的假设。

entries.en: Our adwriter suggested a shorter headline for the station poster.
entries.zh: 我们的广告文案撰写人为那张车站海报建议了一个更简短的标题。

entries.en: The survey team measured the entrances to the two adyta.
entries.zh: 测绘队测量了那两座内殿的入口。

entries.en: Only fragments of painted plaster remained inside the adytum.
entries.zh: 内殿中只剩下了一些彩绘灰泥碎片。

entries.en: Several aecidia were visible on the infected leaf under magnification.
entries.zh: 放大观察时，可以在那片受感染的叶子上看到几个锈孢子器。

entries.en: A single aecidiospore remained in focus as she adjusted the microscope.
entries.zh: 她调节显微镜时，一枚锈孢子始终清晰地呈现在焦点上。

entries.en: We photographed the rim of the aecidium through the microscope.
entries.zh: 我们通过显微镜拍下了那个锈孢子器的边缘。

entries.en: The entomologist added a closer view of the beetle's aedeagus to the illustration.
entries.zh: 昆虫学家在插图中补上了那只甲虫阳茎的局部放大图。

entries.meaningZh: 小型建筑物〔建筑学，指小型神龛〕
entries.en: The restorer found traces of red paint on the aedicule's columns.
entries.zh: 修复人员在那座小型神龛的柱子上发现了红色颜料的痕迹。

entries.meaningZh: 小型建筑物〔建筑学，指小型神龛，复数〕
entries.en: The architect drew two aedicules to house statues beside the entrance.
entries.zh: 建筑师画了两座小型神龛，用来安放入口旁的雕像。

entries.en: In her historical novel, an aedile quarrels with the organisers of the games.
entries.zh: 在她的历史小说中，一位营造官与竞技活动的组织者发生了争吵。

entries.en: The collector wrapped the piece of aegirine before placing it in the drawer.
entries.zh: 收藏者先把那块霓石包好，再放进抽屉。

entries.en: A small crystal of aegirite had broken away from the specimen.
entries.zh: 一小块霓石晶体从那件标本上脱落了。

entries.meaningZh: 全球人寿保险公司〔公司名 Aegon〕
entries.en: She had left her umbrella at Aegon's reception desk.
entries.zh: 她把雨伞落在了全球人寿保险公司的接待处。

entries.en: Aelian leaned across the table to reach the salt.
entries.zh: 艾利安探身越过桌子去拿盐。

entries.en: The model aeolipile stopped turning before the demonstration ended.
entries.zh: 演示结束前，那个汽转球模型就停止了转动。

entries.en: Visitors gathered around the working aeolipyle in the museum courtyard.
entries.zh: 参观者围在博物馆庭院里那台正在运转的汽转球旁。

entries.en: Ignoring the material's aeolotropy made the model's predictions less accurate.
entries.zh: 忽略材料的各向异性使模型的预测不够准确。

entries.en: Rain delayed the aerification of the golf course greens.
entries.zh: 下雨耽误了高尔夫球场果岭的通气作业。

entries.en: The groundskeeper parked the aerifier beside the mower after finishing the lawn.
entries.zh: 草坪管理员完成草坪作业后，把通气器停在了割草机旁。

entries.en: The mechanics found a loose bracket beneath the aero-engine.
entries.zh: 机械师们在航空发动机下方发现了一个松动的支架。

entries.en: A dent in the aero-radiator was visible through the open cowling.
entries.zh: 透过打开的整流罩，可以看到航空散热器上的一处凹痕。

entries.en: Her work in aerobacteriology began with a study of indoor air samples.
entries.zh: 她在大气细菌学领域的工作始于一项室内空气样本研究。

entries.en: The aeroballistics team questioned the drag assumptions in the simulation.
entries.zh: 空气弹道学团队质疑了那项模拟中的阻力假设。

entries.en: The aerobat waved to the crowd after climbing out of the cockpit.
entries.zh: 那位特技飞行员爬出驾驶舱后向人群挥手。

entries.en: We compared the growth of this aerobium in two different media.
entries.zh: 我们比较了这种需氧微生物在两种不同培养基中的生长情况。

entries.en: The inert aerobomb was too heavy for the museum's display stand.
entries.zh: 那枚无爆炸能力的航空炸弹太重，博物馆的展台承受不了。

entries.en: We waited inside the aerobridge while the cabin crew prepared the aircraft.
entries.zh: 机组乘务人员准备飞机时，我们在登机桥内等候。

entries.en: The pilot checked that the aerocamera was secure before boarding.
entries.zh: 飞行员登机前检查了航空照相机是否固定牢靠。

entries.en: A worn gear interrupted the surveyor's work on the aerocartograph.
entries.zh: 一个磨损的齿轮打断了测绘员使用航空照片制图仪的工作。

entries.en: The damaged aerocraft remained in the hangar throughout the winter.
entries.zh: 那架受损的飞行器整个冬天都停在机库里。

entries.en: The aerodynamicist suggested testing a different shape in the wind tunnel.
entries.zh: 空气动力学家建议在风洞中测试另一种形状。

entries.en: An aeroelastician joined the design review to discuss the wing's vibration.
entries.zh: 一位气动弹性力学家参加了设计评审，讨论机翼的振动问题。

entries.en: The wind tunnel footage revealed aeroelasticity that the rigid model had missed.
entries.zh: 风洞录像显示出了刚性模型未能反映的空气弹性变形。

entries.en: The apprentice listened carefully as the aeroengine started.
entries.zh: 飞机发动机启动时，那位学徒仔细地听着。

entries.en: Studying aerogeology changed the way she interpreted aerial photographs of the valley.
entries.zh: 学习航空地质学改变了她解读那片山谷航空照片的方式。
